history.summary: A well-built Wheelock-developed 1,012 sqft 3BR in Ang Mo Kio, 430m from Mayflower TEL station, asking $2,075 PSF — fractionally below the project's $2,101 URA median. Backed by a strong 6.1% resale CAGR over 195 transactions and a high liquidity profile (698 units, deep data), this is a solid, well-priced D20 buy with the main caveats being efficient-but-tight unit size and some early ageing of communal areas.
history.rating_rationale: Strong fundamentals: 6.1% URA resale-only CAGR over a robust 195 transactions (no new-launch bias) is among the best verified appreciation in the batch; $2,075 PSF is at/slightly below the $2,101 median so no overpaying; 698 units and TEL connectivity (Mayflower 430m) give deep liquidity; $2.1M quantum sits in the deepest buyer band. Reputable developer (Wheelock) with generally good build feedback. Score 738 / MMR 1539, on the frontier. Tempered from Strong Buy by reports that communal/roof facilities are ageing faster than expected and occasional lift/utility complaints, the relatively compact 1,012 sqft for a 3BR, and a 99yr lease (from 2013) that is fine now but not a freehold scarcity play.
red_flags: Reviews cite early wear on communal/roof facilities and intermittent lift/electrical issues despite 2019 build
Compact 1,012 sqft for a 3BR — efficient but tight, modest size premium
PSF already at project median — limited mispricing to exploit; relies on continued growth
catalysts: 6.1% URA resale CAGR over 195 txns — strong, well-evidenced appreciation
430m to Mayflower TEL station — one-line ride to Orchard/Marina Bay
698-unit development in popular AMK/Bishan-Thomson belt — deep liquidity and schools (Ai Tong nearby)
Thomson Line maturation continuing to lift the corridor
